# Formulas

Generated from `content/detection.json` and the economy constants in
`tools/economy_model/data.py`. This replaces §29.1, which still carries
the detection model §12.17 superseded (C1) — the worst place for a stale
number, since it is where an implementer looks for it.

## Detection (§12.17)

| What | Formula |
| --- | --- |
| Tick rate | 30 a second, fixed (§24.10) |
| Suspicion | 0 to 1000, per guard |
| Fill, near zone | 67 a tick (~0.5 s to full) |
| Fill, mid zone | 33 a tick (~1.0 s to full) |
| Fill, far zone | 12 a tick (~2.8 s to full) |
| Decay | 20 a tick (~1.7 s from full) |
| State floor | 15 ticks before a state may fall back |
| States | Unaware 0, Suspicious 200, Investigating 600, Alerted 1000 |
| Alarm spread | guards within 4.0 m, 15 ticks later |
| Realm alarm | 0 to 6; +1 per 30 s and +1 per guard found; reinforcement at 5 |
| Ambush | first hit on an Unaware guard: a knockout after a 2 s takedown, in all 25 role pairings; level advantage counts for at most 3 levels |

### Guard vision

| Guard | Cone | Near | Mid | Far | Corner of the eye | Turn |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Scout | 45° | 2.0 m | 4.0 m | 6.0 m | 110° | 6°/tick |
| Warden | 40° | 1.5 m | 3.0 m | 4.5 m | 90° | 3°/tick |
| Breaker | 35° | 1.5 m | 2.5 m | 3.5 m | 70° | 8°/tick |
| Carrier | 30° | 1.0 m | 2.0 m | 3.0 m | 60° | 4°/tick |
| Mender | 40° | 1.5 m | 2.5 m | — | 100° | 4°/tick |

### Noise

| Action | Heard within |
| --- | --- |
| crawling | silent |
| crouched walk | 1.0 m |
| walking | 2.5 m |
| running | 4.5 m |
| landing 1 level | 2.0 m |
| landing 3 levels | 4.0 m |
| breaking | 5.0 m |

Sound travels along the walkable path, never through walls. Guards off screen hear at 50% strength.

## Economy

| What | Formula | Section |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stability capacity | 30 + 8 x Spire level, plus every Anchor Stone (8 + 5 x its level) | 5.5 |
| Strain bands | Quiet under 40%, Steady under 70%, Humming under 90%, Brimming under 100%, Strained under 110%, Cracking under 125%, then Breaking | 5.5 |
| Production | base x 1.35^(level-1) x staffing x law bonuses x realm match x worker bonuses x band bonus x faults | 9.3 |
| Staffing | 60% / 85% / 100% for one, two, three workers | 9.2 |
| Heist clock | 150 s + 15 s per link on the shortest route, up to 240 s | 5.4 |
| Keeper curve | day ~ 0.13 x level^1.96 for an engaged player | 14.2 |
| Births | 100 x 1.15^(ruleborn owned) Essence | 9.5 |
